name: agentcore-assistant
description: A skill that helps you build, deploy, and operate AI agents on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore. Bundles a dependency-free CLI that indexes live documentation, API references, SDK patterns, boto3 methods, and CDK/CloudFormation templates from 13 official AWS sources, plus curated best-practice and anti-pattern references. Adapts to intent — exploration, migration, architecture advice, or full implementation.
